[9:01PM] #OjoduBerger #TrafficUpdate 

Ojodu Berger is experiencing a mix of traffic conditions.
Key areas like Otedola Bridge to Berger and Isheri Olowora to River Valley are moving smoothly.
Omole area, including Omole Junction and VIS, is fast-moving. 
While River Valley to Kosoko is slow due to commercial activities, other stretches like Excellence Yaya Abatan to Wempco and Wempco to Lateef Jakande are flowing well.
With traffic personnel actively managing the situation, the roads are largely clear, and commuters are experiencing minimal disruptions.
